command.title: 偏多，但新增資金先留現金
command.action: 既有股票曝險以 66.6–75.0% 為 review zone；目前沒有 BUY，不為了湊滿上限追價。
decision_confidence_reasons: prospective validation has not matured yet

allocation.note: The zone is not a new model target: lower/upper bounds are the existing v2.1 challenger review and v1 champion outputs.

context.label: BROADLY_SUPPORTIVE
context.text: 景氣、成長延續、金融條件與內需同向偏強；屬廣泛支持的風險背景。

top_verify.name: 技嘉
top_verify.next_check: Q2正式財報；Q1 fundamental已超過130天freshness gate，未更新前不得升BUY。

top_verify.name: 光寶科
top_verify.next_check: 下一季EPS/營益率與Power Shelf/HVDC進度。

alpha.selection_text: 目前沒有 BUY CANDIDATE；有 2 檔處於 VERIFY，需等待 freshness / evidence / valuation gate 完整通過。

decision_delta.message: 和最近 prospective baseline 相比，核心決策條件沒有實質變化。

rationale.title: Macro environment
rationale.text: 景氣、成長延續、金融條件與內需同向偏強；屬廣泛支持的風險背景。

rationale.title: Model uncertainty
rationale.text: Effective data confidence 88.5; Structural Break HIGH; prospective resolved 0.

rationale.title: Alpha deployment gate
rationale.text: 0 BUY · 2 VERIFY. Risk capacity does not force security selection.

scenarios.label: 市場熱度歸零
scenarios.description: 把 6M market momentum 設為 0，其餘條件不變。
scenarios.contract: same training set; one declared counterfactual state; diagnostic sensitivity only

scenarios.label: AI 集中回中性
scenarios.description: 把 AI Concentration 設為 50，其餘條件不變。
scenarios.contract: same training set; one declared counterfactual state; diagnostic sensitivity only

scenarios.label: 景氣四維同步 -15
scenarios.description: Cycle / Growth / Domestic / Financial 各下降 15 分。
scenarios.contract: same training set; one declared counterfactual state; diagnostic sensitivity only

scenarios.label: 市場回檔情境
scenarios.description: 6M momentum 下修 15pp，trailing drawdown 至少 -15%，macro 不變。
scenarios.contract: same training set; one declared counterfactual state; diagnostic sensitivity only

scenarios.label: 景氣四維同步 +10
scenarios.description: Cycle / Growth / Domestic / Financial 各上升 10 分。
scenarios.contract: same training set; one declared counterfactual state; diagnostic sensitivity only

counterfactuals.note: These are model sensitivities, not causal estimates or forecasts. Each scenario uses the exact same historical training set as the current v2.1 review.

increase_risk.label: 出現真正 BUY candidate
increase_risk.meaning: 只有這個條件滿足，新增股票資金才有 security-level 去處。

increase_risk.label: 市場感知 Risk Budget 回到 champion 附近
increase_risk.meaning: 代表 market-aware challenger 不再明顯要求比 v1 更保守。

increase_risk.label: Structural Break 降回 WATCH / NORMAL
increase_risk.meaning: 歷史類比更可信時，才值得提高對模型 sizing 的信心。

decrease_risk.label: Market-aware equity budget 跌破 60%
decrease_risk.meaning: 代表歷史 outcome evidence 已不再支持偏多風險配置。

decrease_risk.label: 景氣四維平均跌破 40
decrease_risk.meaning: 不是單一數據轉弱，而是廣泛 macro support 明顯失速。

decrease_risk.label: Effective Data Confidence 跌破 75
decrease_risk.meaning: 資料本身不夠可靠時，先縮小動作而不是強行輸出精確 allocation。

private_portfolio_policy.rule: Above zone: reduce toward upper bound. Inside zone: hold unless a BUY candidate justifies selective deployment. Below zone with no BUY: preserve cash rather than force exposure. Below zone with BUY: deployment capacity is capped by the lower review bound.
